programme.title: Liderzy. W centrum gry – Julian Shehu | E04
programme.desc: The series directed by Maciej Klimek presents five PKO BP Ekstraklasa players who took responsibility for their teams at the decisive moments of the 2025/26 season. The heroes are Jesus Imaz (Jagiellonia Białystok), Rifet Kapić (Lechia Gdańsk), Radosław Murawski (Lech Poznań), Julian Shehu (Widzew Łódź) and Karol Czubak (Motor Lublin). Cameras follow them on and off the pitch, showing the pressure, behind-the-scenes of matches and their private lives. Widzew Łódź quickly became one of the richest clubs in Poland. He brought in expensive players, but despite this, the team fell into crisis and had to fight to stay in the PKO BP Ekstraklasa. Julian Shehu, who had been at the club for several years, did not have star status. During a difficult period, he grew into one of the team leaders. The creators of the series show his importance for the team and his path from Albania to Poland, visiting the places where he started his football career. Poland. 2026. documentary series

programme.title: d/s Drain the Oceans (Malaysia Airlines Flight 370)
programme.desc: Where did Malaysian Airlines Flight MH370 go? Computer graphics reconstructions and insights from leading seabed scientists show the complexities of locating the crash site of a plane that disappeared into the ocean at great depths. Why did MH370 disappear without a trace, why did the most modern technologies not help find its wreckage? Dir.: Michael Davies, Christopher Riley, Sophie Elwyn-Harris. Led by: Craig Sechler. USA, UK

programme.title: d/s Drain the Oceans (Secrets of the Chinese Seas)
programme.desc: The seas of China are home to some of the largest naval battles in history, shrouded in mystery for over 700 years, as are the wonders of technology both ancient and modern. Hydrolocation sonar technologies, combined with computer graphics, make it possible to reconstruct the largest naval ships of that time ever launched, unusually effective weapons of antiquity, and also show underwater threats that could destroy the global Internet in an instant. Dir.: Michael Davies, Christopher Riley, Sophie Elwyn-Harris. Led by: Craig Sechler. USA, UK

programme.title: d/s Air Crash Investigation (Design Flaws)
programme.desc: When the plane of one of Niki Lauda's former racing drivers unexpectedly dived into the Thai jungle, the cause of the accident was a defective element, the failure of which was estimated to have a one-in-a-million chance. The accident exposed a serious design flaw in the Boeing 767. One part of the fuselage of a Turkish Airlines DC-10 broke off during flight, causing one of the worst air disasters of its time. To determine the cause of the crash of Atlantic Southeast Airlines Flight 2311, it was necessary to conduct risky flight tests. Dir.: George D'Amato, James Hislop. Cast: Jason Weinberg, Bill Lake, Dennis Akayama, Jerry Mendicino, Hrant Alyanak, Jean-Marc Fontaine, Brendan Wall. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003, documentary

programme.title: d/s Air Crash Investigation (Plane crash over the Atlantic)
programme.desc: The risk of flights can be reduced to almost zero, but repeated aircraft accidents indicate that it is necessary to develop a backup system in the event of emergency situations. A cargo plane carrying 90,000 pounds of denim crashes to the ground seconds after takeoff. A plane carrying a military unit unexpectedly crashes into a hangar in North Carolina, prompting experts to suspect a serious defect in the plane's design. The National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is rushing experts to Afghanistan to the crash site of a turbojet plane loaded to capacity with armored personnel carriers. Dir.: George D'Amato, James Hislop. Cast: Jason Weinberg, Bill Lake, Dennis Akayama, Jerry Mendicino, Hrant Alyanak, Jean-Marc Fontaine, Brendan Wall. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. A young Venezuelan decided to take the risk of smuggling because of a squabble in his family. The old man can't believe that cocaine was found in his luggage, and neither can the relative he called from the airport. An old man from the Marshall Islands caught with drugs confirms the fact that drug lords have begun to actively attract older people to their business. USA

programme.title: d/s Airport Security: First Class (Frequent Air Passengers)
programme.desc: These drug couriers continue their attempts to transport drugs by air, deceiving airport security services in Colombia and Peru. A Spaniard with a load of cocaine is simply shocked by the fact that drugs were found on him. A man carrying a cargo of cocaine bound for the Dominican Republic assures customs officers that he has been there before. A man caught with drugs on his second trip claims he was forced to do it. A woman tries to board a plane using someone else's passport. An Indonesian woman tries to smuggle cocaine and currencies from different countries. The drug courier claims that he knows about the impending smuggling of cargo weighing almost 1,000 kilograms. USA

programme.title: d/f Revolution LSD and psychedelic
programme.desc: Delving into the world of psychedelics, this documentary traces the journey of LSD and psilocybin from their ancient roots in Egypt to modern research in Detroit. For years these substances were banned, but today researchers, activists and healers are fighting to recognize their potential in everyday life. We'll look at how psychedelics help people cope with cluster headaches and post-traumatic stress disorder. Get ready to learn about a revolution that is changing our understanding of psychedelics and their role in modern society. USA

programme.title: d/s Air Crash Investigation (Courage in the cockpit)
programme.desc: Becoming an airline captain requires years of training, but it is only in the event of a critical situation on board the aircraft that it becomes clear whether the captain is worthy of his rank. The airliner crashes just after takeoff from New York's LaGuardia Airport, and the fearless captain makes a difficult landing right on the Hudson River. A catastrophic failure of one of the plane's systems occurs right over the Canadian prairies and turns the Boeing 767 into a very large and very heavy glider. Evolution Earth: Grasslands (S1 E5). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2023. S1, Ep5
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: JAV. Год: 2023. S1, Ep5 «Evolution Earth»…Explore one of Earth's most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planetEvolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. Heading out across the globe to distant wilds and modern urban environments, five episodes track how animals are moving, using ingenuity to adapt their behavior, and even evolving in unexpected ways. At the front lines of this rapid change are the scientists, filmmakers and local communities recording the animals' stories. We follow heart-warming tales of resilience that redefine our understanding of evolution, and hint at how nature can show us a path towards a sustainable future for Planet Earth. The series is narrated by Dr. Shane Campbell-Staton, who guides us through each episode in an intimate narrative style, drawing on his background as an evolutionary biologistDirector: Charlotte LathaneCast: Shane Campbell-Staton

programme.title: Deep in the Heart. Documentary about nature. USA, 2022
programme.desc: 2022 г. Год: 2022. Страна: JAV. Год: 2022. «Deep in the Heart. A Texas Wildlife Story»…Take a journey through the eyes of catfish, ocelots, and other native creatures with narrator Matthew McConaughey. Celebrate the Lone Star State's landscapes and wildlife, and learn how crucial conservation efforts can save Texas' unique habitatsDirector: Ben MastersCast: Matthew McConaughey

programme.title: Baby Animals: Fresh Meat (S1 E4). Documentary about nature. USA, 2015. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep4 «Baby Animals»…Infancy isn't all fun and games. Some animals must hit the ground running to avoid becoming dinner for predators. Take an in-depth look at what life is like for newborn animals that must learn fast your die youngArctic foxes, sea otters, tamarin monkeys and red pandas are just some of the tiniest, cutest creatures featured in Baby Animals. With their big eyes and wobbly first steps, nature's newbies are irresistible. Watch how animals nurture their young as infant elephants, baby bison and rambunctious rhinos all eat, sleep and play their way to adulthood in their respective natural habitats. Cuddly, clumsy and full of mischief, the babies of the animal kingdom certainly make up the wildest daycare you've ever seen. Find out how it all happens

programme.title: d/s Best friends (Tommy and Humphrey/Jake and Roo)
programme.desc: Tommy the donkey began to follow Humphrey the camel everywhere from the first day they met, and now they are inseparable friends. Dir.: Sarah Marino. Canada

programme.title: d/s Saving Australian Wildlife (Sofia the Flying Fox)
programme.desc: Dr Bree and the team at Byron Bay Wildlife Hospital examine an adorable five-week-old flying fox with a sore wing and Lover, a green sea turtle who was struck by a boat propeller. Australia

programme.title: d/s Ancient China from a bird's eye view (Anhui)
programme.desc: Anhui is located in Eastern China, on the border of southern and northern China. The Yangtze and Huai Rivers divide Anhui into South, Central and North Anhui, Huangshan Mountain stands proudly in the mountains of South Anhui. Dir.: Anthony Barwell, Christopher O'Donnell. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/s Such different animals (Squirrel)
programme.desc: Despite all the diversity of shapes and sizes, the animals of our planet are actually much more similar than they might seem at first glance. This fascinating documentary takes you on a fascinating journey to discover the surprising parallels between seemingly completely different species.

programme.title: d/s Discovering Langkawi. 2 s.
programme.desc: Mangroves are one of many species in Langkawi that illustrate the theory of evolution that those most adapted to change are more likely to survive

programme.title: d/f Heroine of Savannah
programme.desc: In the animal kingdom, males are usually the ones who assert authority over females. However, in some species the opposite occurs, with the addition that female leaders lack bodily qualities and visible physical superiority. There are matriarchies that have the added benefit of playing their part in the most demanding and harshest ecosystem on the entire planet: the African savanna

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife (Jungles of Asia)
programme.desc: The authors decided to make a kind of rating of the most outstanding representatives of the animal world. With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife (Open Ocean)
programme.desc: The authors decided to make a kind of rating of the most outstanding representatives of the animal world. With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA

programme.title: d/s Natural family ties (Friends forever)
programme.desc: Experience the close friendships that some wild creatures form and understand the importance of having true allies in the animal kingdom. Explore group dynamics and building trust. Dir.: Juan Luis Santos. Spain

programme.title: d/f Normandy: between sky and sea
programme.desc: The film is dedicated to the unique and fragile ecosystem of the rocky Cape Carteret in Normandy. After human activity has damaged the local fauna, two iconic predators - the peregrine falcon (a tireless hunter) and the raven (distinguished by special intelligence) - are gradually reclaiming these wild spaces. A kind of confrontation over territory is unfolding between them. France

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife (The Strongest)
programme.desc: Mighty grizzly bears. Tiny strong ants. A swift, inimitable throw of a crocodile. Indestructible armor of the rhinoceros beetle. Who will be called the strongest on our planet? USA

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife (Fastest)
programme.desc: Do you know which animal is the fastest? In this series we'll meet authentic wildlife walkers: kangaroo, cheetah, zebra and bald eagle. USA

programme.title: d/s The most dangerous animals (Africa)
programme.desc: The wilds of Africa are the stage on which many species participate in the eternal dance of life and death. USA

programme.title: d/s Strategies in the wild (Masters of attack)
programme.desc: Ideal hunters: dolphin traps, crocodiles patience, spider skills. What incredible abilities help predators survive. Dir.: Max Serio, Bettina Dalton. Czech Republic, USA

programme.title: d/f Mysteries of the Ocean
programme.desc: The underwater world is full of mysteries and wonders. The ocean, with its endless expanses, attracts humanity with its unexplored wealth. What secrets is he hiding from us? This fascinating story dives into the deepest recesses of the ocean to show us life in its depths and reveal the majesty of underwater worlds hidden from human eyes. USA

programme.title: d/s Green animals (Hunger satisfaction)
programme.desc: In this series, we will explore which plants can help satisfy the hunger of different animal species. Director: Song Seung-woo. South Korea

programme.title: d/f The Incredible Journey of a Snail
programme.desc: A small gray snail travels an unusual path of two thousand kilometers - from the forests of France to the Faroe Islands. The film captures her movement through different environments and landscapes, showing the scale and complexity of this journey. You will see how even the most fragile creature can overcome vast distances. France

programme.title: d/s Animal Superpowers (Superhuman Senses)
programme.desc: A series that explores the amazing senses of animals and their evolution. Why do snakes have forked tongues and elephants have huge ears? How do bats and moths use their unusual ears and antennae for orientation? In each episode, we explore how these features, which at first glance seem strange, play a key role in survival. Like humans, animals rely on their senses to find food, communicate, and avoid danger. An in-depth look at how evolution has created unique tools to adapt to our environment. Dir.: Max Serio, Bettina Dalton. USA, Czech Republic

programme.title: d/s Animal Superpowers (Sixth Sense)
programme.desc: A series that explores the amazing senses of animals and their evolution. Why do snakes have forked tongues and elephants have huge ears? How do bats and moths use their unusual ears and antennae for orientation? In each episode, we explore how these features, which at first glance seem strange, play a key role in survival. Like humans, animals rely on their senses to find food, communicate, and avoid danger. An in-depth look at how evolution has created unique tools to adapt to our environment. Dir.: Max Serio, Bettina Dalton. USA, Czech Republic

programme.title: My wild cats (My African cats)
programme.desc: Wild cat populations around the world have declined sharply over the past few decades due to habitat loss, poaching and other factors. However, thanks to the creation of protected areas such as national parks and reserves, some species have a chance to survive

programme.title: d/s Secrets of nature. 1 p.
programme.desc: A study of the hunting and defense strategies that animals use to survive. Director: Lee Young-gyu. South Korea

programme.title: d/f I am the best red deer
programme.desc: In autumn, an amazing and exciting story begins in the Mediterranean forest. The Iberian red deer enters mating season when its alarming sounds echo throughout the forest. This is the time when deer defend their territory, compete for the attention of females, and guard their pack. Continuation of the species becomes their main goal, and every battle is not just a fight, but also a chance to secure the future of their species

programme.title: d/f Ice Kingdom of the Snow Leopard
programme.desc: In a secret valley, in the heart of the Tibetan Plateau, lives a mythical and fascinating animal - the snow leopard. Two photographer brothers are on his trail. The extreme conditions they face do not break their determination to photograph this wary predator.

programme.title: d/f Italy. Through the wilderness (Sardinia: the lost world of Terrenia)
programme.desc: This episode takes a new and intimate look at the extraordinary animals of the Mediterranean's second largest island, focusing on the vultures, endemic red deer and large cetaceans found off the island's west coast

programme.title: d/s Kingdom of the Giant Panda (Birth of a Giant)
programme.desc: Unique footage of the birth of a giant panda cub! France

programme.title: t/s Wild Killers (Disguise)
programme.desc: In the wild it is survival of the fittest, and each creature has its own set of skills and weapons. Viewers will get to know poisonous spiders, fast snakes, camouflaged cuttlefish, ferocious sharks and other deadly animals. This exciting journey will reveal the secrets of the hunters at the top of the food chain. Dir.: Paul Dean. USA

programme.title: d/s Wild Animals of Europe (Wild World of the Loire)
programme.desc: This film tells about one of the last wild rivers in nature and the inhabitants inhabiting its banks and waters. France

programme.title: d/s Evolution (Survival)
programme.desc: Patrick explores whether nature's greatest survivors can inspire technologies that will help humanity avoid extinction. Dir.: Chris Baron. USA, Singapore

programme.title: d/s Evolution (Treatment)
programme.desc: Patrick explores the regenerative secrets of evolution. Is there a new medical discovery hiding in a deadly scorpion, a prehistoric predator, or even the smallest animal on Earth? Dir.: Chris Baron. USA, Singapore

programme.title: THE FOOD THAT BUILT THE WORLD S5 EP04
programme.desc: Vào cuối những năm 1800, hai dược sĩ cách nhau 1500 dặm chạy đua để tạo ra các lựa chọn đồ uống không cồn, tốt cho sức khỏe, khởi động toàn bộ ngành công nghiệp soda với những sản phẩm đột phá của họ: Hires Root Beer và Dr. Pepper.

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S11 EP09
programme.desc: Khi nhóm trải qua một thất bại đáng thất vọng, họ choáng váng khi biết rằng điều đó có thể đã dẫn đến một khám phá mang tính đột phá.

programme.title: MYSTERIES UNEARTHED WITH DANNY TREJO S2 EP07
programme.desc: Một số bí mật không chịu được chôn vùi. Cho dù đó là hàng hóa bất hợp pháp trong một hồ nước đóng băng, một kiệt tác bị đánh cắp trị giá hàng triệu USD hay một nhà thổ ẩn mình trong bóng tối của Điện Capitol - sự thật luôn lộ diện.

programme.title: ALONE S12 EP04

programme.title: CỖ MÁY CHIẾN ĐẤU - THE FIGHT MACHINE
programme.desc: Hai chàng trai trẻ người Canada đến từ những thế giới hoàn toàn khác nhau đang bị mắc kẹt trong một cuộc sống ngoài tầm kiểm soát của anh. Khi họ bị kéo vào vòng chiến đấu tay không không thể tha thứ dưới lòng đất, sự va chạm của họ đã khơi dậy một hành trình báo thù, trả thù và khám phá bản thân tàn bạo.

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: BỘ ĐÔI BÁO THÙ - MONKEY TWINS
programme.desc: Sau cái chết bi thảm của người yêu, Neua học Monkey Muay Thái và thề sẽ trả thù cho cái chết của cô. Em gái của người yêu anh, người luyện tập Kung Fu Trung Quốc, ban đầu nghi ngờ Neua phải chịu trách nhiệm, nhưng sau đó phát hiện ra rằng em gái cô đã bị giết bởi một nhóm tội phạm có tổ chức. Cùng nhau, họ hợp lực để bảo vệ công lý và tìm cách báo thù.

programme.title: BẠN CÓ ĐỦ BẢN LĨNH? - RUTE:TOUGHNESS REDEFINED

programme.title: THIẾU NIÊN DIỆP VẤN: THỜI KHẮC NGUY HIỂM - YOUNG IP MAN: CRISIS TIME
programme.desc: Lấy bối cảnh năm 1917, chàng trai trẻ Diệp Vấn theo đuổi việc học ở Hồng Kông. Ngôi trường bị bắt làm con tin vào ngày diễn ra cuộc thi hùng biện tiếng Anh, và khi Diệp Vấn quyết định đứng lên chống lại cuộc khủng hoảng, người ta tiết lộ rằng chủ nhân và người bạn thời thơ ấu của anh đứng đằng sau tất cả những điều này. Liệu anh ta có thể hạ gục họ và bảo vệ công lý?
